rightsEvidence: Museum object page marks this image free and in the public domain; NGA Open Access policy releases eligible images under CC0. Rechecked 2026-10-20.

description.zh-Hans: 天使向马利亚报信。画中两人隔着建筑立柱相对而跪，呼应《路加福音》1章26—38节。
description.en: An angel brings news to Mary. The two kneeling figures face each other across an architectural division. Read Luke 1:26–38 alongside the painting.

context.zh-Hans: 利皮约于1435—1440年以蛋彩绘于木板。文艺复兴时期的室内空间让古老故事变得亲近；它不是圣经时代建筑的记录。
context.en: Lippi painted this tempera panel around 1435–1440. Its Renaissance interior brings the story into a familiar setting, rather than documenting biblical architecture.

observe.zh-Hans: 编辑观察：先沿天使的视线寻找马利亚，再看鸽子、光线与手中书本。画家如何用空间把两个人既分开又连接？
observe.en: Looking prompt: follow the angel’s gaze to Mary, then find the dove, rays and book. How does the space both divide and connect the figures?

rightsEvidence: Museum object page marks this image free and in the public domain; NGA Open Access policy releases eligible images under CC0. Rechecked 2026-10-20.
dimensions:
overall (diameter): 137.3 cm (54 1/16 in.)
framed: 188 x 171.5 x 12.7 cm (74 x 67 1/2 x 5 in.)

description.zh-Hans: 人群绕过山丘和建筑，来到马利亚与婴孩面前。《马太福音》2章1—12节记载博士献礼；经文没有给出博士的人数。
description.en: A procession winds toward Mary and the infant. Matthew 2:1–12 recounts the visitors’ gifts, but does not specify how many visitors there were.

context.zh-Hans: 这幅约1440—1460年的圆形蛋彩画由安杰利科开始、利皮完成。馆方将它与佛罗伦萨当时纪念博士来访的游行文化联系起来。
context.en: Begun by Fra Angelico and completed by Lippi around 1440–1460, this circular tempera painting relates to Florence’s contemporary celebrations of the Magi, according to the museum.

observe.zh-Hans: 编辑观察：从前景的献礼者向远处追踪队伍。圆形边界、弯曲道路和多个人群，怎样让一个安静的相遇变成公共庆典？
observe.en: Looking prompt: trace the procession from the gift bearers into the distance. How do the round frame, winding route and crowds turn a quiet encounter into a public celebration?

rightsEvidence: Museum object page marks this image free and in the public domain; NGA Open Access policy releases eligible images under CC0. Rechecked 2026-10-20.

description.zh-Hans: 法老的女儿发现婴孩摩西，并怜悯他。请结合《出埃及记》2章1—10节，辨认篮子、婴孩与围绕他的众人。
description.en: Pharaoh’s daughter discovers the infant Moses and takes pity on him. Read Exodus 2:1–10, then locate the basket, baby and gathering figures.

context.zh-Hans: 委罗内塞约于1581—1582年绘制此画。馆方指出，他以当时的华服和宫廷随从重新想象故事；这些服饰不是古埃及的考古复原。
context.en: Painted by Veronese around 1581–1582, the scene reimagines the story through contemporary finery and a courtly entourage, as the museum explains. The costumes are not an archaeological reconstruction of ancient Egypt.

observe.zh-Hans: 编辑观察：衣料的光泽很醒目，但视线和手势都指向婴孩。你的目光先落在哪里，又如何回到故事中心？
observe.en: Looking prompt: the rich fabrics attract attention, while glances and gestures lead toward the baby. Where does your eye begin, and how does it return to the story’s center?

title.en: Christ at the Sea of Galilee

artist: Anonymous artist, probably Lambert Sustris (attribution uncertain)
rightsEvidence: Museum object page marks this image free and in the public domain; NGA Open Access policy releases eligible images under CC0. Rechecked 2026-10-20.

description.zh-Hans: 复活后的耶稣在岸边向捕鱼的门徒显现。馆方将此画联系到《约翰福音》21章1—13节；不要将它与耶稣履海的另一段故事混为一谈。
description.en: The risen Christ appears to the disciples as they fish. The museum connects this scene to John 21:1–13; it should not be conflated with the separate story of Jesus walking on water.

context.zh-Hans: 作品约作于1570年代。馆方认为作者可能是兰伯特·苏斯特里斯，但尚不能确定；它曾被归于丁托列托。
context.en: Dating to about the 1570s, the painting is probably by Lambert Sustris, though the attribution remains uncertain. It was formerly attributed to Tintoretto.

observe.zh-Hans: 编辑观察：近岸人物与远处小船被大片水面隔开。观察波浪、天光和手势如何跨过这段距离，让相认成为画面的重点。
observe.en: Looking prompt: a broad stretch of water separates Christ from the boat. Notice how waves, light and gestures bridge that distance and draw attention to recognition.
